notes.zh-CN: 移除 Grok 输入框中的「多 Agent」开关及附加提示词，发送内容保持原样；Grok CLI 原生的子 Agent 能力不受影响。macOS 为 universal 开发签名，未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Removes the Grok composer's Multi-agent toggle and its injected instructions so prompts are sent unchanged. Grok CLI's native subagent support is unaffected. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
